close_reason: SesMailer implemented behind 'ses' feature flag using aws-sdk-sesv2. Tests use wiremock mock server. 200/400/429/500 error classification tested.
description:
## Why this issue exists

Phase 3a of epic stoa-y0p2j. Implement OutboundMailer for AWS SES v2 (SendEmail API). The SES impl is chosen first because aws-sdk-sesv2 is the most used of the HTTP providers and has well-documented mock/testing patterns. Other providers (SendGrid, Mailgun, Postmark) are deferred.

## What needs to be done

1. Add feature flag 'ses' in stoa-smtp Cargo.toml; gate aws-sdk-sesv2 behind it
2. Implement SesMailer: OutboundMailer in crates/smtp/src/ses_mailer.rs
   - authenticates via IAM role (no hardcoded credentials; standard aws-config chain)
   - parses RFC 5322 raw bytes to extract From/To/Subject for SES API call
   - returns SES MessageId in SendReceipt
   - maps SES 4xx as transient, 5xx as permanent in OutboundError
3. Test with wiremock or httpmock mock HTTP server (no live AWS calls in CI)
4. Verify feature-flag isolation: cargo check --no-default-features compiles clean

## Acceptance criteria

- SesMailer compiles only under feature 'ses'
- Test with mock HTTP server verifies correct SendEmail request shape
- Permanent vs transient error classification correct
- cargo hack check --feature-powerset --depth 2 -p stoa-smtp clean
title: Phase 3: SES HTTP API provider implementation
